race_name: Gravel Unravel - Bon Jon Pass Out

top_categories.workout_context: 62ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Gravel Unravel - Bon Jon Pass Out, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gravel Unravel - Bon Jon Pass Out. Train it until it feels boring.
Gravel Unravel - Bon Jon Pass Out's Olympic Peninsula, Mountain gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 80 miles.
5,000ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gravel Unravel - Bon Jon Pass Out's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
At mile 60 of 80, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 80 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Gravel Unravel - Bon Jon Pass Out, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Tempo is Gravel Unravel - Bon Jon Pass Out's race pace. The wattage you'll hold for 80 miles on olympic Peninsula gravel. Train it until it's automatic.
Low-cadence force work for 5,000ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
Smooth pedaling at 80 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Gravel Unravel - Bon Jon Pass Out’s 80 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Gravel Unravel - Bon Jon Pass Out requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on olympic peninsula gravel to build confidence. Expect: olympic peninsula, mountain gravel, pacific northwest.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and G Spot to prepare you for 80 miles of olympic peninsula gravel in Quilcene, WA.
